title: TimeLens: Rethinking Video Temporal Grounding with Multimodal LLMs

problems.name: Dataset, Benchmark, and Evaluation Mismatch
problems.evidence_sentence: For data quality, we focus on benchmark diagnosis, benchmark reﬁnement, and creating a reliable evaluation suite.

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel at various video understanding tasks, the recipes for optimizing them for VTG remain under-explored.

problems.name: Scalability and Corpus-Level Retrieval
problems.evidence_sentence: We also address noisy training data through an automated re-annotation pipeline, yielding TimeLens-100K, a large-scale, high-quality training dataset.

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: Beyond evaluation, we also ﬁx the noisy training data by automated re-annotation, yielding TimeLens-100K, a large-scale, high-quality training dataset.

methods.name: Contrastive or Cross-Modal Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: These include interleaved textual encoding for time representation, a thinking-free reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) approach as the training paradigm, and carefully designed recipes for RLVR training.

methods.name: LLM Reasoning, Agentic Workflows, or RL Post-Training
methods.evidence_sentence: These include interleaved textual encoding for time representation, a thinking-free reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) approach as the training paradigm, and carefully designed recipes for RLVR training.

methods.name: Multi-Modal Fusion and Feature Enhancement
methods.evidence_sentence: TimeLens: Rethinking Video Temporal Grounding with Multimodal LLMs This paper does not introduce a novel method but instead establishes a straightforward, incremental, yet essential baseline for video temporal grounding (VTG), a core capability in video understanding.
